expectedBehavior: A Micronaut annotated ACP agent bean (@Singleton + @AcpAgent, acp-micronaut) is run two ways, and Micronaut ACP clients built from acp.client.* talk to it. (1) stdio: a Micronaut client application launches the packaged agent application (java -jar micronaut-agent.jar) as a process. It prints the initialize response JSON it received, with agentInfo name micronaut-greeting-agent, version 1.0.0, title 'Micronaut Greeting Agent', sessionCapabilities list and close, promptCapabilities.embeddedContext true and loadSession false, all derived from the annotations (no @Initialize). A prompt shows a thought from a Micronaut @Around interceptor ('[audit] prompt call #1') and the answer "Hello from Micronaut: you said 'hi over stdio'" (returned as a Publisher<String>) with stop reason end_turn; session/list reports 1 session, and after session/close 0 sessions. The client closes and the agent process exits. (2) HTTP: the same application runs in-process with acp.agent.transport.type=http on port 0 (true); a Streamable HTTP client and then a WebSocket client each connect, see agentInfo micronaut-greeting-agent and protocol version 1, and get the greeting with end_turn; the interceptor's count goes on across the connections (call #1 then call #2). The agent application closes. Ends with '=== Demo Complete ===' and no exceptions, stack traces, or ERROR log lines.
requiredOutput: --- 1. stdio: a Micronaut client launches the Micronaut agent application ---
thought: [audit] prompt call #1, intercepted by a Micronaut @Around interceptor
agent: Hello from Micronaut: you said 'hi over stdio'
agent application listening (port 0 -> a free port): true
agent: Hello from Micronaut: you said 'hi over Streamable HTTP'
thought: [audit] prompt call #2, intercepted by a Micronaut @Around interceptor
agent: Hello from Micronaut: you said 'hi over WebSocket'
